oedipally: In a manner related to an Oedipus complex.
oedipean: Relating to Oedipus or the Oedipus complex.
oeillade: A glance, especially an amorous one; an ogle
oenology: The scientific study of wines and winemaking.
oenomel: A beverage made of wine and honey.
oenophile: A person who has a fondness or appreciation for wine.
oersted: The CGS unit of magnetizing field (symbol Oe), defined as 1000/4π (≈79.5774715) amperes per meter of flux path.
oesophagus: The tube that carries food from the pharynx to the stomach.
oestrum: A biting insect; a gadfly or botfly.
oestrus: A biting fly of the genus Oestrus; a botfly.
oeuvre: A work of art, music or literature.
